name: Orkas
cost: Free (MIT). The packaged app comes with 500 credits; paid plans start at $11.99 a month. With your own keys, your provider bills you
works_with: macOS 12+, Windows 10+, Linux from source; runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes-Agent
short: A desktop app where a Commander agent splits your goal into to-dos and hands them to 16 specialist agents and your coding agents.
what: You tell the Commander what you need. It does small tasks itself and, for bigger ones, plans the steps and brings in its built-in specialists (research, writing, slides, video, office files, e-commerce) plus any CLI agents you already have installed. Projects keep goals, rules, memory and files between chats, and scheduled automations repeat routine work. Your data stays on your computer by default.
who: People who want a team of agents for ongoing work like content, research, reports or store operations, and who like a desktop app over code. If you only want one chatbot or a library to build on, the README says it is not for you.
needs: The packaged app: macOS 12+ or Windows 10+, and an Orkas sign-in
From source: Node 22.12+ on macOS, Windows or glibc 2.34+ Linux x64/arm64
Optional: your own API keys for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, MiniMax or Doubao, or a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint

steps.title: Download the app
steps.text: Get the installer from orkas.ai/download. The link detects your system. The packaged app asks you to sign in and gives you 500 credits for the built-in model, so you don't need an API key to start.

steps.title: Or run it from source
steps.text: This is the only way to run it on Linux today. The first launch downloads its own Python, Node, an embedding model (about 95 MB), FFmpeg, whisper.cpp and other tools.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas.git
cd Orkas
./run.sh           # macOS / Linux
run.cmd            # Windows

steps.title: Add a model
steps.text: In a source build, open Settings → AI Providers and add an API key or OAuth. For a local model such as Ollama or LM Studio, go to Account settings → Models → Chat → Add model → Custom and enter the base URL, model ID and key.

steps.title: If native modules fail
steps.text: Use Node.js 24 LTS, then run this from the checkout. `npm run native:check` checks without installing.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Hand VideoStudio a reference clip and your own footage: "Use reference.mp4 as a reference for a 30-second vertical promo. Keep its hook, typography and pacing, replace the content with my product and screen recordings, and show me the breakdown and plan first."

watch: The built-in Orkas model runs through Orkas's managed service. With your own keys, calls go straight to your provider.
Voice input sends your audio to Orkas for recognition and uses the key owner's credits.
Connectors reach Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, Shopify, Stripe and more. By default Orkas asks before it sends, posts or deletes anything.
It runs external CLI agents as local subprocesses on your machine.
Shared projects, cloud sync and web app publishing are only in the packaged app. Cloud sync stores the data you select on Orkas servers.
Automations only run while your computer is awake and Orkas is open.
